concerns.text: FR-009 requires flagging/excluding records where distance > 100km. Task T019 (Geospatial Matching & Flagging) and T019-join (Geospatial Join Logic) are present but marked [ ] (unchecked/unimplemented). The logic is described but the task is not active, leaving the FR-009 requirement unexecuted.

FR-002 requires filtering records with temperature values outside extreme ranges. Task T017b (Validate Temperature Range) is marked [ ] (unchecked). It depends on T019c-interpolate (also unchecked), leaving the temperature range filter unimplemented.

FR-004 requires including covariates for age, gender, dilemma complexity, and time-of-day. Tasks T028a (Check/Fetch Demographic Covariates), T028c (Derive Dilemma Complexity), and T028d (Derive Time-of-Day) are all marked [ ] (unchecked), leaving the model specification incomplete.

FR-012 requires a sensitivity analysis for the indoor/outdoor confound using an urban/rural proxy. Tasks T028h (Fetch Urban/Rural Proxy) and T033a (Indoor/Outdoor Confound Analysis) are marked [ ] (unchecked). The fallback logic (T033b) depends on the failure of the unchecked primary task.

FR-013 requires testing for non-linearity (quadratic/spline terms). Task T031a (Non-Linearity Analysis) is marked [ ] (unchecked), meaning the spec's requirement for non-linearity testing is not covered by an active task.

SC-001 requires measuring the percentage of matched records. Task T022a (Calculate Match Success Rate) depends on T019a (Log Pre-Exclusion Match Count), which is marked [ ] (unchecked) and depends on the unimplemented T019, breaking the chain of evidence for this success criterion.

SC-005 requires Anderson-Darling testing on residuals. Task T028j (Anderson-Darling Test) is marked [ ] (unchecked) and depends on T026 (Primary Model), which is also unchecked, leaving the statistical validation of model assumptions unimplemented.

FR-001 requires merging Moral Machine data with ERA5 data. Tasks T000-init (Download Moral Machine), T002c (Fetch ERA5 Full), and T002d (Stream & Save ERA5) are marked [ ] (unchecked). The pipeline is blocked because the required data files are missing and the tasks to generate them are not active.

Task T001b contains an unresolved claim marker '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_e0dd8e16 — status=not_enough_info]' within the task description. While the task exists, the presence of unresolved internal claims suggests the task definition is incomplete or relies on missing information, potentially hindering execution.

Task T010 (Create base configuration module) contains multiple unresolved claim markers ('[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_3685fde4]', '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_06bf54a3]', '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_5d139f05]'). These indicate that critical configuration values (thresholds, seeds) are not yet defined, making the task unexecutable as written.
